beats.narration_text: Liam, in for Bear — part four. Physics: sine-driven noise wobble that decays to stillness, elastic drop with a squash burst on impact, a card flip in perspective that reads as two-sided, and a shadow layer that stretches ahead of the mark then snaps back. Weight, mass, and depth.

Your turn. Paste this: drop my logo from above with an elastic spring — squash burst on impact — then add a shadow that stretches ahead and snaps back. Tell me whether the combo reads as object or as character. That gap is where brand lives.
